    Coefficient compiler for the bound BGRS Figure 13E source #

    The exceptional representatives in the Figure-13 argument satisfy alpha ≫ beta = 0. Consequently the source is the seven-vertex bound diagram E, rather than the free five-vertex diagram D. This file builds the coherent arm coefficients needed by E and compiles their generator equations into a Hom-bifunctor retraction of that bound source.

          structure LargeIndecomposable.RoiterFigure13E.Figure13ArmCoefficientData {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Type v} [CategoryTheory.Category.{w, v} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] {X Y Z : C} (alpha : X ⟶ Y) (beta : Y ⟶ Z) (residue : CategoryTheory.End Y →ₐ[k] k) (tau : CategoryTheory.End Y) (middle : ClosedZigzagTransfer.RadicalSquareCoefficientData residue tau) :
          Type (max u w)

          Coherent coefficients on the two arms of Figure 13. Unlike Figure13CoefficientExtensionData, this package deliberately has no outer cross coefficient: in Figure 13E the outer composite is the defining zero relation.

          • alphaZero : (X ⟶ Y) →ₗ[k] k
          • alphaOne : (X ⟶ Y) →ₗ[k] k
          • betaZero : (Y ⟶ Z) →ₗ[k] k
          • betaOne : (Y ⟶ Z) →ₗ[k] k
          • alphaZero_post (a : CategoryTheory.End Y) : self.alphaZero (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp alpha a.asHom) = residue a
          • alphaOne_post (a : CategoryTheory.End Y) : self.alphaOne (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp alpha a.asHom) = middle.coefficientOne a
          • betaZero_pre (a : CategoryTheory.End Y) : self.betaZero (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a.asHom beta) = residue a
          • betaOne_pre (a : CategoryTheory.End Y) : self.betaOne (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a.asHom beta) = middle.coefficientOne a
